name: Kyle Miller
title: Psychologist
description: Before my role with MVS Psychology Group, I have worked in aged care, disability, forensic psychology, and trauma.

name: Lizzie Cupper
title: Psychologist
description: Within this space, my interest areas are quite broad and include mood, health, trauma, and neurodivergence. I have a special interest in supporting people experiencing low mood, trauma, and neurodivergence, and those learning to live well with ongoing health challenges.

name: Luisa Franco
title: Psychologist
description: I aim to create a welcoming, inclusive space for all clients, including those from diverse cultural backgrounds, the LGBTQIAPN+ community, neurodiverse individuals, and people experiencing mood-related concerns.

name: Mr Arlan Ruslins
title: Psychologist
description: To help clients achieve their goals I collaboratively use a range of evidence-based techniques from approaches including cognitive behavioural therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy and schema therapy

name: Mr Brad Rooney
title: Psychologist
description: I have a key interest in providing awareness and support to the LGBTIQA+ community.

name: Mr Max von Sabler
title: Psychologist
description: I have particular interest in working with trauma, including PTSD, complex PTSD, sexual abuse, dissociation, and traumatic early life events. My main therapeutic approach combines psychodynamic and psychoanalytic traditions, particularly Lacanian, with modern techniques such as EMDR. I am the Chair of the Australian Psychological Society’s Melbourne Branch and sit on the Scientific Committee of EMDR Australia.

name: Ms Alison Schofield
title: Psychologist
description: I am skilled in working in a number of domains that are core to many clients’ struggles such as managing unhelpful and persistent beliefs, intense and painful emotions, difficult interpersonal experiences, anxiety, low mood, symptoms of trauma and overwhelming stress. I am experienced across a number of current evidence-based therapies such as cognitive behavioural therapy, dialectical behavioural therapy and schema therapy.

name: Sasha Ruggiero
title: Psychologist
description: Sasha is a psychologist with specialist expertise in trauma, neurodivergence, and complex psychological presentations across the lifespan. Her work is formulation-driven and grounded in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), integrated with contemporary trauma-informed, attachment-informed, and neuroaffirming frameworks. Sasha works with children, adolescents, and adults presenting with developmental trauma, complicated grief, emotional dysregulation, identity exploration, anxiety, mood disorders, and entrenched interpersonal patterns. She has particular expertise in supporting individuals with ADHD, autism, learning differences, and broader neurodivergent profiles — especially where these intersect with trauma, academic challenges, or functional impairment.
